title: Design flaws.
text: Design flaws.. Strange set of cutters. The edges are severely fluted and this creates a challenge when you’re trying to separate them. They get all stuck together. I prefer the clean edges and don’t really think I can use these. They store in a nice, thick plastic holder with a lid. They haven’t rusted after use.
